description: Zonas de alto potencial para el desarrollo de la energía eólica marina is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE. One of the main outcomes of the MSP process is the identification of high-potential and priority use areas. This layer represents areas of high potential for offshore wind energy development. Coverage: Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE. The portal shows the English title as "High potential areas for offshore wind energy development" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Catálogo Oficial de Datos y Servicios INSPIRE. Its keywords include Earth observation and environment, POEM, Nacional, MSP, fuente energética renovable, Zonas sujetas a ordenación. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
